_instructions: Apply these settings to VS Code via Settings > Open Settings (JSON) or File > Preferences > Settings (JSON). Requires Roo Code extension: rooveterinaryinc.roo-cline

architect._comment: Architect mode: Claude Sonnet for high-quality design decisions. Uses subscription — tokens are not free but quality is highest.

code._comment: Code mode: Qwen3-Coder-30B via LiteLLM — FREE. All code generation, editing, and implementation goes here.

ask._comment: Ask/Q&A mode: Claude Haiku — fast and cheap for quick questions and lookups.

debug._comment: Debug mode: Qwen3.5-27B reasoning model — FREE. Deep analysis of bugs and tracing.

review._comment: Review mode: Claude Sonnet for thorough code review. Subscription tokens but worth it for quality gate.
